title: Organisational unit
description: A unit that is no plant (e.g. Group Purchasing) on one of the two levels of the plant hierarchy: level 'business_line' sits beside the business lines, level 'plant' beside the plants. Modules treat it like a business line or a plant of that level.

orgUnitId.description: Business key, e.g. 'GRP-PUR'. Shares the key space of its level: never equal to a businessLineId (level 'business_line') or a plantId (level 'plant').

level.description: Level in the hierarchy business line > plant.

parentId.description: Level 'plant': businessLineId (business_lines@1) or orgUnitId of a level-'business_line' unit it reports to. Level 'business_line': null.

active.description: False once dissolved; never delete (module data keeps the id).

_tableEditRevision.description: Portal table-editor revision; optional on existing documents.

updatedBy.description: Actor persons.id; no copied display name.

editHistory.description: Append-only table-edit actor, UTC time and changed field values; appended atomically with the row write.
